module: Class of a race start position: position and rotation of a start line, with a group ('start', 'rollingStart', 'recovery' or 'other'). It can place a vehicle on it while keeping its relative offset, copy a vehicle's placement and provide the front corners for crossing tests. The module returns a factory: require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/race/startPosition')(race, name). Unlike the other race classes, its first argument is named race.
notes: The groups' role is the one given by the code comment: start, rollingStart, recovery, other. Without a group in the data, a name containing 'Recovery' gives 'recovery', otherwise 'start'.
moveResetVehicleTo uses a logTag variable not defined in the file (nil, with no consequence on the log).
Without repair (repair = false), the vehicle is teleported with spawn.safeTeleport and a corrected rotation.
calculateVehiclePosRot uses the spawn OOBB bounding box: in lowPrecision (vehicle loaded on the first frame), the vehicle is placed 2 m behind and 0.5 m above the position.
The vehicle is oriented facing the line (the line's rotation composed with a half turn on Z).
setToVehicle adjusts the height and slope to the terrain if a TerrainBlock exists.

C.desc: Start position. Fields: race, id (race:getNextUniqueIdentifier()), name ("Start Position <id>" by default), group, pos (vec3), rot (quat), sortOrder, routePoint, originalDistToTarget, staticRoutePoint, staticOriginalDistToTarget.

init.desc: Constructor: id, name, group 'start', null position and rotation.

onSerialize.desc: Serializes name, group, pos, rot (x,y,z,w) and oldId.

onDeserialized.desc: Restores the position from serialized data (group inferred from the name if absent).

getFrontCorners.desc: Corners of the area in front of the position: two lists, one of four points (width and length, toward the back of the line along -Y), the other of two points at 0.4 m.

drawDebug.desc: Draws the start line (filled triangles), a red prism in highlight mode and the name.

calculateVehiclePosRot.desc: Computes the position and rotation to give a vehicle so that it keeps its relative offset from its spawn box, centered on the line.

lowPrecision.desc: true for a vehicle loaded on the first frame.

moveResetVehicleTo.desc: Moves a vehicle to the start position. By default with repair (setPositionRotation); with repair = false, safe teleport.

repair.desc: Default true; false = safe teleport without repair.

setToVehicle.desc: Aligns the start position on a vehicle: center of its front, orientation of the vehicle (or of the terrain under it).

setRoutePoint.desc: Stores the associated road point and its original distance to the target (distToTarget).

setStaticRoutePoint.desc: Stores the static road point and its original distance.
